polls.note: Palver national poll released on 24/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-09587/2026, 5,000 voters by online questionnaire between 20 and 23/Sep, survey funded by the institute itself, 95% confidence (CNN Brasil, UOL, Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital and JOTA). ⭐ IN THE PROMPTED [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THE TWO TIE AT 43%, and it is the house itself changing sign: on 21/Sep it measured Flávio Bolsonaro 42% and Lula 41%. Lula rises 2 points, Flávio Bolsonaro 1, and the one who gives way is Renan Santos, from 11% to 8%, the largest fall of any name in this wave. Augusto Cury stays at 2%, Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema at 1% each. 🗣️ And the SPONTANEOUS scenario of the same wave gives a different result: Lula 41% against 39%, that is, the lead appears when the respondent says the name with no list in front of him and disappears when the list is read out. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 48% AND LULA 45%, with the gap narrowing from 4 to 3 points against the house wave of 21/Sep, within the margin. Lula wins the other four pairings: 45% to 43% against Romeu Zema, 44% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 44% to 36% against Augusto Cury and 44% to 34% against Renan Santos. 🏷️ THE MARGIN DIVERGES BETWEEN OUTLETS: UOL states 2.5pp and CNN Brasil 3.0pp for the same wave. The panel keeps 2.5pp, which is the figure from the article that reproduces the full technical sheet, and records the divergence instead of choosing in silence. Government approval in the same wave: 44% approve against 55% who disapprove, and voting rejection is 53% for Lula, 48% for Flávio Bolsonaro and 34% for Renan Santos and Romeu Zema.

PoderData in partnership with Aya, national poll released on 24/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-01739/2026, 3,000 voters by phone between 20 and 23/Sep, margin of 1.8pp with 95% confidence, survey funded by the institute itself (CNN Brasil, Poder360, SBT News, Jovem Pan, ND Mais and Revista Oeste). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 41% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 39%, and both rose against the house wave of 17/Sep, which measured 37% and 36%: that is 4 points for Lula and 3 for Flávio Bolsonaro, so the distance WIDENED from 1 to 2 points. Augusto Cury gives up from 8% to 6%, Renan Santos stays at 3%, Ronaldo Caiado falls from 3% to 2% and Romeu Zema stays at 1%. Blank and void votes total 4% and undecided voters 2%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 46% AND LULA 45%, and the gap narrowed from 2 to 1 point against 17/Sep because Lula rose 1 point and his opponent stood still. 🔑 AND THE HOUSE TESTS A PAIRING ALMOST NO OTHER HOUSE TESTS, with a result that contradicts the first round order: Augusto Cury beats Lula by 45% to 42%, the same score as 17/Sep, and Flávio Bolsonaro beats Augusto Cury by 41% to 39%. Voting rejection in the same wave: 49% for Lula and 47% for Flávio Bolsonaro.

Alfa Inteligência in partnership with TMC, national poll released on 24/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-02512/2026, 2,700 voters in face to face interviews between 18 and 23/Sep, margin of 1.8pp with 95% confidence, commissioned by Alfa Inteligência itself (Exame, Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital, Revista Oeste, GP1 and TMC). 🆕 IT IS THE FIRST WAVE FROM THIS HOUSE IN THE PANEL, and its reliability here is 2, the lowest in the table, because it is a recent institute with no track record from a closed election. ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 40% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 33%, that is 7 points of distance, against 4 at Datafolha, 4 at Real Time, 2 at PoderData, zero at Palver and 2 the other way at Futura, across the six national polls released on this 24/Sep. And it is still a fall for Lula within the house own series: Exame records that his lead fell from 14 to 7 points against the previous Alfa wave, which is not in this panel. Augusto Cury has 6%, Ronaldo Caiado 5%, Renan Santos 3% and Romeu Zema 1%, with 6% blank and void and 5% undecided. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) THE MAIN PAIRING TIES AT 43% TO 43%, and Lula wins the other four: 46% to 39% against Romeu Zema, 43% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 43% to 37% against Renan Santos and 42% to 39% against Augusto Cury. 🗺️ The house publishes regional breakdowns: Lula has 56% to 24% in the Northeast and 45% to 27% among those earning up to two minimum wages, and Flávio Bolsonaro has 37% to 34% among evangelicals, 42% to 35% in the South and 36% to 33% in the Southeast. Management: 46% approve and 50% disapprove, 55% say Lula does not deserve re-election against 43% who back a new term, and 45% see the country on the wrong track against 37% who see the right one.

Datafolha national poll released on 24/Sep at 18:41 BRT, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-00304/2026, 2,002 people aged 16 or over interviewed face to face between 22 and 23/Sep, margin of 2.0pp with 95% confidence (G1, Folha de S.Paulo, Estadão, Valor Econômico, CartaCapital, NSC Total and VEJA). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 40% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 36%, and the distance WIDENED from 3 to 4 points against the house wave of 17/Sep: Lula rose 1 point and his opponent stayed at the same 36%. Augusto Cury gives up from 6% to 5%, Ronaldo Caiado stays at 4%, Renan Santos at 3% and Romeu Zema falls from 2% to 1%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) LULA HAS 47% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 45%, both one point above 17/Sep, and it is the ONLY one of the six national polls of 24/Sep that puts Lula ahead in that pairing. The 4 point distance in the first round sits at the edge of the 2.0pp margin either way, and the house declares a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) in both rounds. 🔒 THE VOTE DECISION IS LOCKED IN: 80% say they are fully decided and 20% could change, with 87% decided among Lula voters and 85% among those of Flávio Bolsonaro, ten days from the first round. Rejection of the two ties at 45% each. 🏷️ The TSE registration states fieldwork from 22 to 24/Sep and the house published fieldwork from 22 to 23/Sep; the panel keeps the fieldwork from the release and records both.

Real Time Big Data national poll released on 24/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-04202/2026, 2,000 voters by phone and digital recruitment between 19 and 23/Sep, margin of 2.0pp with 95% confidence (CNN Brasil, Exame, Gazeta do Povo, UOL, VEJA, CartaCapital, Sul 21 and Brasil de Fato). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 41% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 37%, and the reading inside the house itself is one of SHRINKING: in its wave of 01/Sep, the last one in the panel, the scenario without Pablo Marçal measured Lula 38% and Flávio Bolsonaro 30%, so the lead fell from 8 to 4 points and the opponent rose 7. Augusto Cury and Renan Santos tie at 6%, Ronaldo Caiado has 2% and Romeu Zema 1%, with 3% blank and void and 3% undecided. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 45% AND LULA 44%, within the margin, after a 44% to 44% tie on 01/Sep. 🏷️ THE NATIONAL LABEL OF THIS REGISTRATION WAS CONFIRMED AT RELEASE, and that matters because it rested only on the sampling plan: the house writes Brazilian electorate in 16 out of 16 state polls in which the methodology settles the scope, which makes that field unable to tell them apart. Two outlets independent of each other, Gazeta do Povo and Exame, published the same registration number, the same 2,000 respondents, the same fieldwork from 19 to 23/Sep and the presidential race with no state breakdown. Voting rejection in the same wave: 50% for Lula and 49% for Flávio Bolsonaro, and 55% say they are discouraged about the presidential election.

Futura Inteligência commissioned by 100% Cidades, national poll released on 24/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-05268/2026, 2,000 voters by phone interview between 19 and 23/Sep, margin of 2.2pp with 95% confidence, survey funded by the institute itself (CNN Brasil, Exame, Portal VV8, Band FM and Diário 360). ⭐ IT IS THE ONLY ONE OF THE SIX NATIONAL POLLS OF 24/Sep THAT PUTS FLÁVIO BOLSONARO AHEAD IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), with 40.4% against 38.4%, and the switch happens inside the house itself: on 17/Sep it measured Lula 38.3% and Flávio Bolsonaro 37.7%. Lula stood practically still, 0.1 point higher, and his opponent rose 2.7. Ronaldo Caiado rises from 4.5% to 5.7% and passes Augusto Cury, who falls from 6.5% to 5.6%; Renan Santos gives up from 3.4% to 2.4% and Romeu Zema stays at 0.9%. Undecided voters are 3.2% and blank and void 2.1%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 49.4% AND LULA 43.7%, and the 5.7 points of distance fall OUTSIDE the 2.2pp margin, which the house describes as a statistical advantage. Its gap widened from 4.4 to 5.7 points against 17/Sep, with Lula at exactly the same 43.7%. 📌 AN ADVANTAGE OUTSIDE THE MARGIN IN THAT PAIRING IS NOT NEW IN THIS BASE: of the 34 second round readings between the two already recorded in the panel, 11 fell outside the margin of the poll itself and 8 of them favoured Flávio Bolsonaro, including Gerp on 09 and 17/Sep, Veritá on 06/Sep and this same house on 17/Sep. The house also measures two other pairings in which Lula does not win: Ronaldo Caiado 46.5% to 42.4% and Romeu Zema 43.8% to 43.3%. Government approval in the same wave: 44.2% approve against 53.3% who disapprove.

AtlasIntel in partnership with Bloomberg, national poll released on 23/Sep, fieldwork from 17 to 22/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-04739/2026, 5,015 participants by online questionnaire, margin of 1.0pp with 95% confidence (CartaCapital, CNN Brasil, JOTA, Estadão and Brasil de Fato). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 45.8% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 43.4%, and the distance between them did NOT move: both rose 1.7pp against the house's previous round, of 17/Sep, when they stood at 44.1% and 41.7%. What gave ground was the whole third way, Renan Santos from 5.1% to 4.5%, Augusto Cury from 3.5% to 2.1%, Ronaldo Caiado from 1.7% to 1.3% and Romeu Zema from 1.1% to 0.9%, plus blank and null from 1.6% to 0.7%. ⭐ THE HOUSE TESTED FIVE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIRINGS AND LULA WINS OR TIES ALL FIVE: 47.7% to 47.4% against Flávio Bolsonaro, 47.6% to 42.2% against Romeu Zema, 46.6% to 44.0% against Ronaldo Caiado, 46.2% to 39.4% against Augusto Cury and 46.5% to 31.2% against Renan Santos. 🔑 IN THE MAIN PAIRING THE SIGN FLIPPED inside the house's own series: on 17/Sep Flávio Bolsonaro had 47.2% against 46.8%, and now Lula comes out numerically ahead by 0.3pp, well below the 1.0pp margin. It is the third week running of a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) in that pairing. In valid votes the pairing comes out 50.2% to 49.8%. 🏷️ The TSE registration declares 5,000 interviews and the house published 5,015; the panel keeps the realized number.

Palver national poll released on 21/Sep, registration BR-00860/2026, 5,000 voters interviewed online, 2.8pp margin at 95% confidence, fieldwork from 15 to 20/Sep (Folha de S.Paulo, UOL, CNN Brasil, JOTA, Gazeta do Povo and Correio Braziliense). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 42% AND LULA 41%, one point of distance that fits within a single margin, so the firm measures a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). ⭐ RENAN SANTOS APPEARS THIRD WITH 11%, against 2% for Augusto Cury, 1% for Ronaldo Caiado and 1% for Romeu Zema. ⭐ THE FIRM TESTED FIVE SECOND-ROUND PAIRINGS AND LULA SCORES 43% IN ALL FIVE: he loses to Flávio Bolsonaro 43% to 47%, to Romeu Zema 43% to 44% and to Ronaldo Caiado 43% to 44%, and beats Augusto Cury 43% to 35% and Renan Santos 43% to 34%. His number does not move with the opponent: all the variation is on the other side. ⚖️ BTG/NEXUS, RELEASED THE SAME DAY AND WITH FIELDWORK CLOSING ON THE SAME 20/Sep, measures the opposite sign in the main pairing and also inverts the order of the third way, with Augusto Cury at 6% and Renan Santos at 3%. 🏷️ The methodology declared in the registration is an online survey through social media ads, with a NON-PROBABILITY sample controlled by quotas and iterative weights anchored in IBGE and [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) data. ⚠️ Gazeta do Povo publishes Lula with 40% in the first round, where Folha and Araripina em Foco publish 41%; the panel keeps 41% and records the divergence between coverages.

BTG/Nexus national poll released on 21/Sep, the firm's 15th wave in the series, registration BR-00485/2026, 2,006 voters by phone via CATI between 18 and 20/Sep, 2.0pp margin at 95% confidence, commissioned by BTG Pactual bank (UOL, Poder360, CNN Brasil, Gazeta do Povo, Opera Mundi and the firm's own site). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 40% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 37%, with Augusto Cury at 6%, Ronaldo Caiado at 5%, Renan Santos at 3%, Romeu Zema at 1% and Samara Martins at 1%, plus 4% blank, null or none and 2% no answer. ⭐ THE FIRM TESTED FIVE SECOND-ROUND PAIRINGS AND LULA WINS OR TIES ALL FIVE: 46% to 45% against Flávio Bolsonaro, 44% to 43% against Augusto Cury, 45% to 45% against Ronaldo Caiado, 47% to 41% against Romeu Zema and 47% to 39% against Renan Santos. His number ranges from 44% to 47% depending on the opponent. ⚖️ PALVER, RELEASED THE SAME DAY AND WITH FIELDWORK CLOSING ON THE SAME 20/Sep, measures the opposite sign in the main pairing and inverts the order of the third way, with Renan Santos at 11% and Augusto Cury at 2%. 🏷️ The [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration declares 2,000 interviews and the firm published 2,006; the panel keeps the number actually carried out.

[Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) national poll released on 21/Sep at 18:06 BRT, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-06004/2026, 2,004 voters aged 16 or over interviewed face to face between 17 and 20/Sep, 2.0pp margin with 95% confidence, commissioned by Grupo Globo (CNN Brasil, CartaCapital, Poder360, CBN and Folha de S.Paulo). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 37% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 33%, with Augusto Cury at 6%, Ronaldo Caiado at 4%, Renan Santos at 3%, Romeu Zema at 1% and Samara Martins at 1%, plus 7% blank, null or will not vote and 8% undecided. Against the house's previous round, Flávio Bolsonaro moves 2 points up and Lula 1, both inside the margin. ⭐ THE HOUSE TESTED FIVE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIRINGS: Flávio Bolsonaro has 42% against 41% for Lula, and Lula wins the other four, 41% to 39% against Ronaldo Caiado, 41% to 38% against Renan Santos, 39% to 35% against Augusto Cury and 46% to 32% against Romeu Zema. ⚖️ IT IS THE THIRD NATIONAL SURVEY WITH FIELDWORK CLOSING ON THE SAME 20/Sep, alongside BTG/Nexus and Palver, and the three use different methods: face to face, telephone and online. In the first round the distance between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro comes out at 4 points here, 3 points at BTG/Nexus and 1 point in Flávio Bolsonaro's favor at Palver. 📌 The house also measured government approval, 44% against 50% disapproval, and the administration rating, 33% positive, 23% fair and 42% negative. 🏷️ The panel names this round after the commissioner declared at release, Grupo Globo; earlier rounds by the same house are on the panel as Quaest/Genial, and the comparison with the previous round is the one the house itself published.

AtlasIntel in partnership with Bloomberg, national poll released on Sep 17, fieldwork from Sep 11 to 16, register BR-06221/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 5,018 voters by online questionnaire, margin of 1.0pp and 95% confidence, cost declared in the register of R$ 75,000 (Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital, Brasil de Fato and GPS Brasília). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THE DISTANCE WITHIN THE HOUSE NARROWED FROM 5.6 TO 2.4 POINTS: Lula went from 43.0% to 44.1% and Flávio Bolsonaro from 37.4% to 41.7%, against the Sep 10 round. The 2.4 points still fall outside two margins of 1.0. Renan Santos has 5.1%, Augusto Cury 3.5%, Ronaldo Caiado 1.7%, Romeu Zema 1.1% and Samara Martins 0.7%, with 1.6% blank and null and 0.5% no answer. The house does not include Pablo Marçal. ⚖️ IN THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 47.2% AND LULA 46.8%, a distance of 0.4 point inside one margin, and in the Sep 10 round it was 0.2 point, 46.4% to 46.2%. In the other pairs Lula wins all four, all outside two margins: 46.3% to 43.7% against Romeu Zema, who on Sep 10 appeared 0.2 point ahead of him, 46.0% to 41.7% against Ronaldo Caiado, 45.6% to 37.8% against Augusto Cury and 46.1% to 29.7% against Renan Santos. 🏛️ Government evaluation is 45.4% approval against 53.6% disapproval, with 0.9% no answer (Gazeta do Povo and GPS Brasília).

PoderData/Aya national poll released on Sep 17, fieldwork from Sep 13 to 16, register BR-00360/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 3,000 interviews by automated calls to landlines and cell phones, margin of 1.8pp and 95% confidence (CNN Brasil, CartaCapital and Gazeta do Povo, and the TSE register matches sample, fieldwork and method). ⚖️ IN THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 46% AND LULA 44%, the same 2-point distance as the Sep 10 round, when the pair was 47% to 45%. The 2 points fit inside two margins of 1.8, so the house measures a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). Against Augusto Cury, Lula loses 42% to 45%, also inside two margins, and in the pair between the two names on the right Flávio Bolsonaro beats Augusto Cury 43% to 36%, outside them. 🗳️ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 37% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 36%. Augusto Cury has 8%, against 10% in the Sep 10 round, Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado 3% each, and Romeu Zema and Pablo Marçal 1% each, with 4% blank and null and 2% who do not know. The house keeps Pablo Marçal in the scenario, although the TSE rejected his candidacy registration on Sep 11.

Gerp national poll released on Sep 17, fieldwork from Sep 14 to 16, register BR-00535/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 2,400 telephone interviews, margin of 2pp, cost declared in the register of R$ 12,000 (CNN Brasil, Exame and Gazeta do Povo). ⚖️ IN THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 50% AND LULA 43%, the same 7-point distance as the Sep 9 round, when the pair was 47% to 40%. The 7 points fall outside two margins of 2, and this is the only one of the three national polls of Sep 17 in which the runoff leaves the statistical tie. 🗳️ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 40% AND LULA 37%, the same 3-point distance as the Sep 9 round, which fits inside two margins. Augusto Cury has 7%, Ronaldo Caiado 3% and Renan Santos 2%, with 4% blank and null and 4% who do not know. The names below 2% appear in only one of the sources read and stay out of this entry.

Datafolha national poll released on Sep 17 at 19:04 Brasília time, field Sep 15 to 16 as declared by the firm, register BR-04029/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 2,002 people aged 16 or over, margin of 2.0pp and 95% confidence (G1, Folha de S.Paulo, Valor Econômico and Brasil de Fato). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THE FIRM REPEATS LULA AT 39% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO RISES FROM 35% TO 36%, a distance of 3 points that fits inside two margins of 2.0 and is therefore a [technical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). Augusto Cury has 6%, Ronaldo Caiado 4%, Renan Santos 3%, Romeu Zema 2%, Samara Martins 1% and Rui Costa Pimenta 1%, with 6% blank, void and none and 3% undecided. Among valid votes Lula has 43% and Flávio Bolsonaro 39%. ⚖️ IN THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) LULA HAS 46% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 44%, the same numbers as the firm's two previous waves, meaning three straight measurements with no movement on that pair. 🚫 ON REJECTION THE TWO TIE AT 47%, against 46% each on Sep 11; Renan Santos has 15%, Romeu Zema 14%, Ronaldo Caiado 13% and Augusto Cury 9%. 🏛️ Government assessment is 48% approval against 50% disapproval. 📌 IN THE UNPROMPTED QUESTION, where the firm does not show the names, Lula has 35% and Flávio Bolsonaro 26%, and the undecided fall from 23% to 21%.

Futura Inteligência contracted by 100% Cidades, national poll released on Sep 17, field Sep 11 to 15 as declared by the firm, register BR-00749/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 2,000 voters by computer-assisted telephone interview, margin of 2.2pp and 95% confidence (Exame, CNN Brasil, UOL and Itatiaia). 🏷️ THE TSE REGISTERS THIS FIRM AS "100 CIDADES" AND THE PRESS CALLS IT "FUTURA" OR "FUTURA/100% CIDADES", and this record keeps both names on purpose, because the register name alone does not find the release. ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 38.3% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 37.7%, a distance of 0.6 point inside a margin of 2.2. Augusto Cury has 6.5%, Ronaldo Caiado 4.5%, Renan Santos 3.4%, Pablo Marçal 1.9% and Romeu Zema 1.0%, with 2.7% blank and void and 3.4% undecided. ⚖️ IN THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 48.1% AND LULA 43.7%, a distance of 4.4 points that falls outside two margins. 🔴 THIS IS THE READING THAT INVERTS DATAFOLHA FROM THE SAME DAY, which gives Lula 46% to 44%. 🚫 ON REJECTION LULA HAS 49.7% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 45.3%, with Pablo Marçal at 16.9%, Renan Santos at 16.6% and Romeu Zema at 15.9%. 🏛️ Government assessment is 44.1% approval against 53.1% disapproval, and on the performance scale 36.5% excellent or good, 15.8% fair and 47.2% poor or terrible.

DataTrends national poll released on Sep 16, fieldwork from Sep 12 to 14, register BR-08691/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 2,000 interviews by telephone with automated answering (IVR) across the 27 federative units, margin of 2.19pp with 95% confidence, declared cost of R$ 25,000.00 (Correio Braziliense, Revista Oeste and Blog do Edmar Lyra, and the TSE register matches sample, fieldwork and cost). ⭐ THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIR AGAINST LULA CAME OUT 45% TO 44% FOR FLÁVIO BOLSONARO, a 1-point difference that fits inside one margin, so the house measures a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 39% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 35%, four points that fit inside two margins of 2.19. Augusto Cury has 6%, Renan Santos 4%, Ronaldo Caiado 3% and Romeu Zema 1%, with 4% blank and null and 8% undecided.
